finished_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D4 independent project exemplar, composition and decisions matter, not necessarily more details than D3. Scene: An airy summer meadow with an asymmetrical island of pale pink and red wildflower masses at middle left, broad yellow-green sunlit grass and muted-teal shadow groups in lower right, open pale gray-green breathing spaces and small pale cyan sky. No trees, fences, path or people. Flower brushwork simplified broad clusters. Keep square composition spacious, not more detailed than D3. Palette: 37 yellow-green; 44 yellow olive; 58 muted teal; 9 pale pink; 11 red; 172 extremely pale gray-green; 67 pale cyan. Keep relative hue character, these are planning labels not calibrated exact colors.
